summary: Nathaniel Wallich earned an M.D. from the University of Aberdeen (~1819) and an honorary doctorate from the University of Copenhagen (~1821). He served as Superintendent of the Indian Botanic Garden (1817-1846) and Vice-President of the Linnean Society of London (~1849-1854).

Nathmal Tatia was a scholar of Indology, philosophy, and religious studies who earned a Doctor of Literature from the University of Calcutta under Satkari Mookerjee and Sukhlal Sanghvi. He served as Director of the Jain Vishva Bharati Institute (attested 1982-1990).
Navaneethakrishnan S is an Indologist who earned a Master of Philosophy from the University of Sri Lanka. In 2021, he served as a Senior Lecturer at the University of Jaffna.
Navina Lamminger specializes in Tibetology and Buddhist studies. She completed her PhD at the University of Munich under the supervision of Franz-Karl Ehrhard.

Ngawang Thokmey works in Tibetology, Buddhist studies, and philosophy. He served as South Asian bibliographer at the University of Virginia (attested 2003-2008) and later as Assistant Professor of Sakya Sampradaya Shastra at the Central Institute of Higher Tibetan Studies (attested 2026).

Nawang Tsering Shakspo is a scholar in Buddhist studies and Tibetology who studied under doctoral supervisor Lal Mani Joshi. In 1985, he was attested as a Lecturer at the Central Institute of Buddhist Studies.
Nazir Ahmad Dehlvi was an Indology scholar who studied under Mamluk Ali Nanautawi (~1846-1851) at the University of Delhi (~1846-1853). He later taught Ghulam Yazdani.
Neal Donner is a scholar of Buddhist studies and sinology. He studied at the University of British Columbia under the teacher Leon Hurvitz (attested 1976).
Neelima Mundayar is a scholar in religious studies and Indology. Attested in 2026, she is a PhD student at the University of Edinburgh studying under doctoral supervisor Wilfried Swenden.

Nenghai Shi was a Buddhist studies and Tibetology figure who studied at Peking University (~1915-1917) and under Khangsar Rinpoche, among others. He founded the Shaocheng Society of Buddhist Studies (1917) and served as vice-president of the Buddhist Association of China (1953-1966).

Nepal Das is a scholar of Indology and philosophy who studied at RKMVERI (B.A. and M.A., 2011-2016) and National Sanskrit University (M.Phil. and Ph.D., 2016-2022). In 2020, he was appointed Assistant Professor at Central Sanskrit University.
Newton Mohun Dutt worked in Indology and served as Curator of Libraries for Baroda State and at the Central Library of Vadodara from ~1914 to 1930.

Ng-Fung Yuen specializes in Buddhist studies and religious studies. She earned her Doctor of Philosophy at the University of the West under the supervision of Kottegoda S. Warnasuriya (attested 2009).
Ngakchang Gönpo Tsé Ten studied under Dilgo Khyentse Rinpoche and Dudjom Rinpoche.

Ngan-che Chan holds degrees from the University of Hong Kong (PhD), University of Leeds (MSc), and CUHK (MPhil). Supervised by Jing Yin and taught by K. L. Dhammajoti, Chan became an Assistant Professor at CUHK in 2023.
Ngawang Jorden is a scholar in Buddhist studies and Tibetology. He held a post at Sakya College and served as director of the International Buddhist Academy.
Ngawang Lek Shé Gyatso studied under Dilgo Khyentse Rinpoche, Dodrupchen Rinpoche, and Trulshik Rinpoche.

Ngawang Nyima was a scholar of Buddhist studies and Tibetology who studied under the 13th Dalai Lama, the 14th Dalai Lama, and Trijang Rinpoche. He taught Dezhung Rinpoche Kunga Tenpai Nyima, Thubten Jigme Norbu, and Dagpo Rinpoche.
Ngawang Sherpa specializes in Buddhist studies and Tibetology. He earned a PhD in Buddhist studies from Florida State University in 2022 and held a post in religion there the same year.

Ngorpa Pönlob Lo Ter Wangpo studied under Jamyang Khyentse Wangpo, Jamgön Kongtrül Lodrö Thaye, Shechen Gyaltsab, and Jamgon Ju Mipham Gyatso. He taught Shenphen Nangwa and Jamyang Khyentse Chökyi Lodrö.
